# `indicator/coverage`

`buildWorkspaceReport` counts candles, indicator points and the channels that answered,
and names what is missing. `formatWorkspaceReport` renders that as the one-line string a product
surface shows.

## Example

```ts
import { buildWorkspaceReport, formatWorkspaceReport, type WorkspaceRow } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

declare const rows: readonly WorkspaceRow[];

export const line: string = formatWorkspaceReport(buildWorkspaceReport(rows, null, [], 120));
```

## Exports

- **`buildWorkspaceReport`** · value · `(rows: readonly WorkspaceRow[], indicators: ReadingSeries | null, drawnPanes: readonly ReportedPane[], loadMs: number | null) => WorkspaceReport`
- **`formatWorkspaceReport`** · value · `(report: WorkspaceReport) => string`
- **`ReportedPane`** · type · `interface ReportedPane { series: readonly ReportedSeries[] }`
- **`ReportedSeries`** · type · `interface ReportedSeries { spec: { readonly label: string; }; source: { readonly field: string; } }`
- **`WorkspaceReport`** · type · `interface WorkspaceReport { candles: number; indicators: number; loadMs: number | null; openInterest: number; funding: number; settlements: number; missing: readonly string[] }`
